notes.title: Update: Camera Shake Removed
notes.content:
Update: Camera Shake Removed
Thanks to your feedback, we've removed the shaking camera effect from the Into the Fold: Nala Junction demo. The camera is now more stable and less distracting during gameplay.

We really appreciate the suggestions, this is just a demo, and your input is helping shape the final game. More improvements and updates are coming soon!

notes.title: Update v1.4 – Atmosphere Overhaul, Combat Improvements & More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We’re excited to roll out Update v1.4, a major step forward in making the game feel tighter, smoother, and more immersive. Here’s what’s new:



The official new trailer 1 for Into the Fold: Nala Junction!

This trailer offers a deeper look into the eerie atmosphere, fast-paced boomer shooter combat, and surreal mystery at the heart of the game. 



 Watch the trailer here: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1Q8WHUrqaRQ"][/dynamiclink]



View the full poster here: 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593153/f221ec5e3c23be92b06cc427cdf587d7dbefa6f4.jpg"]



If you haven’t already, try the free demo, and don’t forget to wishlist the game to stay updated!

Thanks for all your support, and more updates are on the way soon.


 Environment & Atmosphere
Massive lighting overhaul: We’ve revamped the overall atmosphere and lighting to better reflect the tone of the world, more tension, more depth, and more mood.

Subtle weather tweaks and fog layers now add to the visual tone of each area.
 Enemies & Combat
Enemy behavior has been improved to feel more responsive and challenging.

New combat animations added for smoother and more brutal action.

Better hit feedback and movement flow during fights.
 VFX & SFX
Some visual effects updated for better clarity and impact.

Sound effects have been tuned to better match the world and enhance combat tension.
 Animations & Camera
New ambient and combat-related animations added for more immersion.

Camera movement has been smoothed out to reduce distortion and improve gameplay flow.

VFS camera system now feels more natural, especially during fast-paced sequences.
 General Fixes & Balancing
Various glitches and minor bugs squashed.

Overall game balancing improved for a more consistent and fair experience.

Slight tweaks to the feel of movement and interaction for better overall gameplay flow.



The free demo is available now as part of Steam Next Fest (June 9–16, 2025). Wishlist now and step into the nightmare.



Thank you for all the feedback—it’s helping shape the game into what it’s meant to be. We’ve got more coming soon, so stay tuned… and as always, don’t forget to wishlist or leave a review if you’re enjoying the ride!

— Gallic Entertainment

🛠️ Into the Fold – Demo Update: UI Improvements & Bug Fixes

📋 Summary:
We’ve pushed a small but important update to the demo! This patch improves the UI, fixes mesh glitches, and adds smoother gameplay overall. Your feedback is helping us polish every corner of the experience,  keep it coming!

🖱️ What’s New:
✅ UI Enhancements
Added Feedback Form button on the main screen so you can quickly tell us what you think.

Added Wishlist on Steam button to support the game with one click.

🐛 Bug Fixes & Polish
Fixed mesh-related visual glitches in multiple areas.

Improved environmental collision and object placement.

Minor performance tweaks for smoother gameplay.
